title: espeletia grandiflora var. hartwegiana
intro: Espeletia grandiflora var. hartwegiana, commonly known as 'Hartweg's Columbian Tree-Phacelia', is a flowering plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Espeletia grandiflora var. hartwegiana include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
